environment.description: Same Go binary deployed inside a gVisor (runsc) container with a custom OCI runtime configuration. The container's root filesystem is a read-only squashfs mount assembled via ko with only the Go binary and CA certificates (no shell, no /etc/passwd, no sensitive files). The PostgreSQL connection uses a dedicated role 'ws_readonly' configured with row-level security policies enforcing tenant isolation, and the role is granted SELECT only on a materialized view 'entity_updates_v' which exposes only (id, name, status, updated_at) columns with no JOIN capability. The database has pg_stat_statements disabled and the role has no access to pg_catalog or information_schema via REVOKE. Additionally, the container runs under a seccomp profile that blocks execve, and the process is chrooted to /app which contains only the binary. Network egress is restricted to the RDS endpoint on port 5432 only via Cilium NetworkPolicy with DNS-aware rules.

config.runtime: gVisor runsc with custom seccomp (no execve)
config.filesystem: read-only squashfs, chroot to /app containing only binary + CA certs
config.schema_access: REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA pg_catalog, information_schema FROM ws_readonly
config.view_definition: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW entity_updates_v AS SELECT id, name, status, updated_at FROM entities WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
config.network_policy: Cilium L7, egress only to RDS endpoint:5432
config.sensitive_data_exposure: none - view contains no PII columns, no access to users/orders/payments tables
